rationale.conceptual: The method consists of evaluating an explicit algebraic formula and solving a scalar implicit equation via standard numerical root‑finding (e.g., brentq). Both formulas are stated in the paper, no derivation or custom algorithm is needed. This is textbook‑level implementation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has only two independent steps, each producing a single CSV file. The solve.sh runs two sequential invocations of the same script; the orchestration is minimal.
